Receivers can mark internal messages as read

policies.qual:
((auth.uid() = sender_id) OR (auth.uid() = receiver_id) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM users
  WHERE ((users.id = auth.uid()) AND (users.role = 'admin'::user_role) AND (users.status = 'active'::account_status)))))

policies.with_check:
((auth.uid() = sender_id) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
